title: TIF-105 pre-M2 quantitative failure-mode sweep of desktop computer-use agents
question: What actually fails in desktop computer-use agents today, how often, model vs harness, and which failures would Myco's state oracles, fault injection or verified procedures fix?
key_claims: Failure mix inverted 2024 -> 2026: click grounding from >75% of 550 failed examples (OSWorld paper) to 11 of 144 (7.6%); step-budget exhaustion to 1 of 144; reasoning and control 76 of 144 (52.8%) (CUADebug, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, 50 steps)

Failures end silently: 91-105 of 361 OSWorld-Verified tasks end in a false DONE at 100 steps (86-96% of failed tasks; VLAA-GUI, adjudicator not stated); 81-90 of 108 OSWorld 2.0 trajectories labelled premature stop or false done
Human root-cause labels: model 112 of 144 (77.8%), infeasible-task handling 19, benchmark artifact 10, environment 3, tools 0
Same weights, harness changed: one defect hid 22-28% of Anthropic's reported OSWorld-Verified failures (zoom with batching plus a 16K output cap) and 26% of GPT-5.3-Codex's (image detail)
UIA-only observation on Windows: control-detection failures 62.8% of UFO2-base failures on Windows Agent Arena (n not published)
State verifier matches human adjudication on 113 of 120 tasks against 95 of 120 for an LLM judge (OpenComputer); a screenshot VLM judge accepts 15-28% of failed runs (VeriCUA)
Detection does not repair: recognising an inherited error lifts pass rate 12.2% -> 15.6% (CUA-Recovery); a diagnosed re-run fixes 28.47% of 144 failures against 13.89% blind (CUADebug)
Compiled procedures: Pass^3 +3.6 to +15.8 and per-run cost 15-217x lower, single-run success flat, -5.6 strict and -18.5 partial on long workflows (Simular NSPI)

Ranked M2 bets: completion gate, checkpoint oracles with retry, fault-injected false-success suite, verified procedures, oracle state adapters, guarded steps (moved last after the Minitap v2 read-back ablation: -0.6, 95% CI -7.2 to +6.7)
limitations: Almost every rate is single-source and tagged 1src in the doc; nothing was reproduced
Web pages and arXiv HTML were read through a fetch tool that extracts text; two Anthropic system cards were read by OCR
Procedure breakage under UI drift is unmeasured in the literature (TIF-100); no rate is given or estimated
Gemini computer-use numbers are thin: two vendor headline scores with no published methodology and no failure breakdown
Windows evidence rests on 2024-2025 models; no 2026 frontier per-domain result on Windows was found
The gate-plus-retry lift of 4-8 points is an estimate from two single-source inputs, to be tested

First verifier pass failed at b15a00f: one source had been read at a superseded arXiv version (Minitap v1) and several table locators were wrong; every arXiv source was then re-checked against its latest version
decision: adopt as the evidence base for M2 planning; ranks six M2 bets and proposes issues P-1..P-8 linked to TIF-98..102; does not decide the A/B/C product choice (MVP Discovery owns that)
reopen_if: a lab adds an outcome field to its computer-use tool contract; a state-adjudicated study puts false DONE under 10% of tasks for frontier agents; a 2026 frontier per-domain Windows result shows Office solved; a study measures procedure breakage across real app versions; a benchmark reports false success under injected faults

key_claims: Abstract: 'intent-evidence dominance inversion': an unreferenced screen region takes over a step's decision from the instruction

Abstract: Intent Counterfactual Probing (redirected instructions) and Region Causal Audit (ablated regions) measure displacement of the decision state; a gated conformal score gives a finite-sample false-positive guarantee; no trigger knowledge or attack data needed
Abstract: evaluated on Qwen2.5-VL-3B across five attack families; threat model is downloaded open-weight GUI agents
limitations: Abstract only; it does not say whether 'decision state' needs model internals or works black-box
Backdoor detection for open-weight agents; Myco runs frontier closed models and does not ship agent weights
decision: reject for now: threat model (backdoored open-weight agents) is not Myco's; each step needs extra counterfactual runs; access requirements unstated
reopen_if: Myco ships or recommends an open-weight agent, or the method is shown to work black-box on closed models
